capabilities: search references from an exported bibliography inside Obsidian
create or open literature notes for references from configurable templates
insert links and content for literature notes
extras: Docs are written around a Zotero + Better BibTeX workflow; other reference managers are not yet officially supported, and the BibLaTeX export is recommended over JSON but loads more slowly.
motivation: The author wanted to integrate an academic reference manager with the Obsidian editing experience.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to search an academic reference library or insert formatted citations and literature notes from it.

relations.evidence: Insert Markdown citation (no hotkey by default): insert a Pandoc-style citation for a particular reference.

requires.name: Zotero (or another reference manager with BibLaTeX/CSL-JSON export)

summary: Bibliography plugin that reads BibTeX or CSL-JSON exports, lets you search references, insert citations, and create literature notes from a Zotero library.
